NASA sent a crew past the Moon just to test if their ship actually works
caption:
NASA's Artemis II crew flew further from Earth than any humans since the 1972 Apollo mission. On Flight Day 3, they were closer to the Moon than to Earth.

Looking out the docking hatch, one crew member described it as 'a beautiful sight.' No CGI. No simulation. Real footage, real people, real spacecraft.

Artemis II was a test run to make sure the crew systems work before anyone lands. If it checks out, Artemis III puts boots on the Moon's surface for the first time in over 50 years.
